name: legal-contract-review
description: Three disciplines read the SAME contract in parallel — compliance/regulatory, legal/liability, and commercial terms — then a synthesizer merges their findings into one redline set, and counsel makes the accountable sign-off (a locked human gate). Showcases `converge` + `merger` for multi-lens review, ending in a `lock` for the call that a human must own.

inputs.description: The contract / MSA / SOW / NDA to review (upload the document).
